versions.changelog:
**Major upgrade introducing STAR+ compliance-first prompt framework and workflow node refinement:**

- Introduced the STAR+ 合规前置 prompt structure across all workflow nodes, ensuring standardized, compliant, and actionable outputs.
- Refined fund operation workflow by detailing each of the 6 core nodes into actionable sub-nodes with MBTI trait mapping for precise role-task alignment.
- Added actionable prompt templates and usage principles (角色、框架、约束、痛点) to drive practical, business-ready AI suggestions.
- Enhanced SOPs for fund e-commerce/fintech operations, team role assignment, and compliance integration in daily processes.
- Provided troubleshooting guidance and practical case examples for improved output quality and execution.
